source: PLACEHOLDER, not measured: plausible hand-picked values for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on vLLM >= 0.31, one TP4 replica on 4x H200 (fp8 KV cache, DSpark speculative decoding). Refit from an Explorer H200 sweep before quoting any number produced with this profile.
notes: Step time: decode_step_base_us + decode_step_per_seq_us * decoding sequences, plus prefill_us_per_token per uncached prompt token computed in the step (a prefill-only step pays prefill_base_us instead of the decode base). Capacity: ~38 GiB of KV per replica at ~30 KiB per token gives ~20k blocks of 64 tokens; the CPU tier assumes ~64 GiB of host memory per replica. kv_transfer_gbps is in gigabits per second (NIXL between the TP4 groups of a 1P+1D node).
